meta_description: Clifford Electrical Services is a trusted electrician in Birmingham. NICEIC registered, same-day repairs, and new installations. Call 07713 564251 for a quote.
hero_eyebrow: NICEIC Registered — Part P Certified Electrician
hero_subhead: From emergency circuit breakers to full rewires, we're here when you need us across Birmingham and the West Midlands.
services_subhead: Whether it's an emergency fault or a planned upgrade, we handle domestic and light commercial work to the highest safety standards.

services.title: Emergency Callouts
services.desc: Power loss, sparking sockets, or faulty circuits? We attend emergency jobs across Birmingham with rapid response times, 24/7. Most faults identified and resolved on the first visit.

services.title: Fault Finding & Repairs
services.desc: Flickering lights, tripped electrics, or appliances that won't power up. We test thoroughly and fix the root cause — not just the symptom.

services.title: Full House Rewires
services.desc: Tired, outdated, or unsafe wiring? We carry out complete rewires with full Part P certification and building regulation sign-off, often in one week.

services.title: Consumer Unit Upgrades
services.desc: Old fuse boxes replaced with modern consumer units that protect your home better and handle today's demand. Fully compliant with latest regulations.

services.title: New Installations
services.desc: EV charging points, loft lighting, kitchen electrics, and new circuits for extensions. We design and install safely and neatly, with proper certification included.

services.title: PAT Testing & Inspections
services.desc: Landlord safety certificates, workplace PAT testing, and periodic electrical inspections. Quick turnaround and full documentation provided.

about_pullquote: I got into this trade because corners shouldn't be cut on safety in anyone's home.
about_para_1: Clifford Electrical Services started in Birmingham 18 years ago with a simple promise: turn up on time, do the job right, and explain everything clearly. We've built our reputation by treating every house and business as if it were our own, whether it's a minor repair or a complete rewire.
about_para_2: We're NICEIC registered and Part P certified, which means every installation carries full legal backing and building regulation approval. Our customers come back because they trust us to spot problems other electricians miss, and to never overcharge or recommend work that isn't needed.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Called Clifford out on a Sunday evening when our lights kept tripping. He arrived within 45 minutes, found a fault in the kitchen ring circuit, and had it all sorted before bed. Brilliant service, honest pricing, and very polite. Definitely recommend.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Had a full rewire done on our 1960s semi. Clifford explained everything step by step, was tidy, and finished on time. All the paperwork came through properly. You can tell he really knows what he's doing. Will use again if we need anything else.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Got a quote for an EV charging point installation. Cliff was really helpful, explained the options, and the install was flawless. He even tidied up after himself, which is rare. Fair price and professional job. Five stars.
reviews.author: James H.
